title: Where a Coding-Help Request Goes
description: Three coding-help agents, three different questions they answer -- and the mentor who stays in the room for all of them.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: AI-Customized Curriculum and Rolling Out New Agents

educational.audience: Mentors deploying AI help in sessions

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a student's coding question, the learner differentiates which of the three coding-help agents applies and identifies the mentor's role in that path.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin routing diagram where all three branches converge on a human
pedagogical.assessment: Give a student question and ask which agent handles it and what the mentor is doing meanwhile.
